title: Research: finite QQ16 child and rounded half-add contract
body:
## Summary

PR3235 leaves its completed-operation inequalities conditional on a finite implementation. This supplies one actual B1_2 child/half-ADD pair, with nonzero rounding charged at both events.

```text
event11795: L470 frame0 -> frame5, rank1
  two rounded butterfly layers
  child error <= (2 epsilon + epsilon^2) ||x||
event11796: L524 -= L470/2, frame5
  ADD error <= epsilon (||d|| + ||xhat||/2)
```

For bounded p-bit dyadic inputs, quantum q/4 and signed width b-ell+6 cover all intermediates. Two owned buffers clear on entry and exit. The direct word invoice is explicit, including the compound RN cost. Choosing p>=beta+delta+104 meets PR3235's local tolerance. The originally proposed L344 example actually feeds a unit ADD; its exact events and second recipe are retained as controls.

The package pins main463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a and documentary PR3235/3216/3226 heads. Executable inputs are only the retained certificate and immutable native recipe archive. Credit commdata2338, Nick Petalas, Sricharan Vagvala, Tekalign, Ali Romman and the retained QQ16/native lineage. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727#discussioncomment-19003012).

## Evidence

- Before: PR3235 supplies conditional local error allowances; this literal finite child/half-ADD boundary had no implementation receipt.
- After: registered Python3.12.15 replay passes fourteen nonzero-rounding fixtures, 28,679 scalar checks and six control groups. Separate enumeration checks rounding; actual binary64 agrees on every returned component; 625 complex pairs check the local defect bound.
- Optimized Python3.14 replay, Ruff E/F/B/I/UP/C4/SIM and format checks pass. A separate read-only mathematical check found no blocking local issue and reran both scripts. Exact committed-byte and read-only Python3.13 export checks pass for all ten package/input files.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-finite-child-halfadd
python3.14 -Werror -I -O -B research/qq16-finite-child-halfadd/verify.py
python3.14 -Werror -O -B research/qq16-finite-child-halfadd/test_verify.py
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/qq16-finite-child-halfadd
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One isolated package. This is a one-factor local numerical construction. Caller input preparation, global dirty-helper restoration, physical owner routing, recursive tariffs, F17 consumption, all-size implementation and supplier admission remain unproved or unpriced. No favorable complete bill, new kappa, selected-frontier update, full cold replay, human review or formal-kernel verification is claimed. Open next questions are included.
